lag.evidence_source: To examine the prospective relationship between different forms of anxiety and chronotype, we conducted additional regressions to test whether individual differences in anxiety predicted later individual differences in chronotype. We included all subscales of the MASC from T1 as independent variables to predict chronotype at T2 while controlling for T2 levels of anxiety, gender and pubertal status as well as symptoms of depression at both timepoints.
